items.title: Denmark expels Russian military attache, giving diplomat seven days to leave
items.summary: Danish Foreign Minister Lars Lokke Rasmussen said Copenhagen has declared Russia's military attache persona non grata and ordered the diplomat to leave within seven days. He said the decision was communicated to Russia's ambassador during a meeting at the Danish Foreign Ministry.

items.title: Russian military-linked report alleges drone strike on Ukrainian unit in Chuhuiv
items.summary: A Russian military-linked account posted what it described as the aftermath of a jet-powered drone strike on an administrative building in Chuhuiv, Kharkiv region, allegedly used by a Ukrainian drone unit. The report provided a location but no casualty or damage figures.
